data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2021 the Syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 3,340.2m. During 2021 there was a net prior-year reserve movement (gross) of a release of GBP 67.7m driven by a mix of favourable reserve developments in several classes (notably Cargo, Marine Liability, Commercial Property and certain Reinsurance classes) partially offset by adverse developments in discontinued portfolios (notably US trucking liability and International Casualty). Natural catastrophe activity in 2021 (including Uri/Texas freeze, European floods, Hurricane Ida and US tornadoes) materially affected current-year claims but prior-year reserve movements were a net release.
raw_causal_phrases: Reserve releases of GBP 23.0 million in 2021 compare favourably to 2020 which saw a strengthening of GBP 12.0 million. Reserve releases were driven by favourable performance in a host of classes, including Cargo, Marine Liability, Commercial Property (driven by prior year cat releases), War, Financial Lines, and Credit.

Adverse reserve development totalled GBP 94.0 million in 2021 compared to releases of GBP 14.0 million in 2020. The strengthening is predominantly driven by US trucking liability (GBP 33.0 million) and International Casualty (GBP 38.0 million) classes, which saw significant deterioration in the year, driven by adverse experience, changes to the development pattern and prior loss ratios.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding 2020 comparative). Prior-year development (gross) taken from Note 11(a) 'Movements arising from prior year claims' (-67.7). Some class-level movements in the narrative are reported net or 'driven by' and do not provide gross quantified splits (e.g. discontinued lines adverse development of GBP 94.0m is presented in the Discontinued lines note but gross/net attribution by LOB is not fully quantified). Claims development triangle (gross) present and used as supplementary source; RITC and Part VII transfer activity noted in the report but effected at/after year-end and not distorting the 2021 opening/closing comparatives. Where gross figures per LOB were not explicitly stated, amounts are left null and confidence reduced accordingly.
